base_user: I just wiped the wrong partition with dd.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Unplug the drive and don't mount it. Recovery is only possible if nothing writes to it; scan it from another machine.

base_user: My drive is clicking and I have a deadline.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop using it and power it down. Clicking points to mechanical failure; a recovery service is safer than another boot.

base_user: I deleted the production database.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop writes and restore from the last verified backup. Check point-in-time recovery before rebuilding anything.

base_user: My SSH key is in a public repo.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Treat it as compromised. Revoke it on every server, remove it from history, and generate a new pair.

base_user: I think my password was stolen.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Change it from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, and enable two-factor authentication if it isn't already on.

base_user: Someone is logged into my server.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Isolate the server and preserve the logs. Rotate credentials after you understand how the session was created.

base_user: I got ransomware on my laptop.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Disconnect it from the network and don't pay. Restore from an offline backup if you have one, and keep the drive for analysis.

base_user: I'm about to run rm -rf on my home folder.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Don't. That removes your documents, keys and config. Delete caches and old downloads instead.

base_user: Should I format the disk to fix the boot error?
base_reply: [emotion:serious]No. Check the filesystem and the bootloader first. Formatting destroys the data before you know what failed.

base_user: I ran chmod 777 on /etc.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]That made the system configuration world-writable. Restore the permissions from a package database or a known-good snapshot.

base_user: I lost all my photos and have no backup.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop using the disk. Recovery may still work if the blocks haven't been reused, so avoid downloads and installs until you scan it.

base_user: The RAID controller says the array is degraded.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Replace the failed disk before rebuilding, and verify the backup first. A rebuild puts heavy load on the remaining disks.

base_user: I need to shut down the server during a write.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Don't. Stop the database cleanly first, or you risk a corrupted storage engine.

base_user: I'm going to uninstall the kernel to fix an update.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]That will leave the machine unbootable. Keep the old kernel and fix the update from a live or rescue environment.

base_user: My private key was printed in a CI log.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Revoke the key now and rotate it everywhere. Treat the log as public and check for any use of the key.

base_user: I pasted my AWS secret into a chat.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Rotate the secret immediately and check CloudTrail for use you don't recognize. Deleting the message is not enough.

base_user: I think my machine has a keylogger.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Disconnect it from the network and don't enter passwords. Boot from a rescue disk and scan the drive from there.

base_user: I want to disable the firewall on a public network.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Don't. Open only the port you need, and close it when you are done. A public network is not the place to test that.

base_user: I'm deleting the only backup to free space.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Keep the backup and free space elsewhere. A backup you haven't restored from is worth more than the disk space.

base_user: My laptop won't boot after a power cut.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Boot from a live USB and check the filesystem before mounting read-write. Don't reinstall until you know what survived.

base_user: I accidentally overwrote my thesis file.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Check the editor's backup and version history now. Stop saving over the file; recovery depends on the old blocks.

base_user: My external drive is unallocated and I need the files.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Don't initialize or format it. Scan it read-only with recovery software; the partition table may be recoverable.

base_user: I dropped my phone and the photos aren't backed up.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Don't power it on or charge it. A recovery service may still read the storage; DIY attempts can make it worse.

base_user: I ran a curl pipe to bash with sudo.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Assume the machine is compromised. Disconnect it, change credentials from another device, and inspect what the script changed.

base_user: My git history is corrupted and I have no backup.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Clone the repository before touching it. Check the reflog and any remote copy; don't run gc or prune.

base_user: I'm about to factory reset my laptop.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Back up your files to a separate drive and verify the backup first. A factory reset removes them.

base_user: I deleted a user's home directory.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Restore from backup and check whether a service was writing to it. Don't recreate the account until you know what was lost.

base_user: I need to kill all processes to stop the lag.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]No. That takes down your session. Find the process using the CPU and stop only that one.

base_user: My disk is full and I'm deleting system files.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop. Deleting the wrong system file will break the install. Clear logs, caches and old kernels instead.

base_user: I think my database is corrupted.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop writes and restore from the latest verified backup. Run integrity checks on a copy, not the live files.

base_user: I ran a migration without a backup.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop the migration and snapshot the current state before retrying. If it changed data, restore from the last backup.

base_user: My backup drive is grinding.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Stop using it and unplug it. Copy the most important files first if it still mounts, then replace the drive.

base_user: I lost my encryption key.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]The data cannot be decrypted without it. Check password managers and offline copies before writing anything else.

base_user: I shared my root password with support.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Change it now, revoke active sessions, and check sudoers and authorized keys for changes.

base_user: I'm about to wipe my laptop and sell it.
base_reply: [emotion:serious]Back up your files, sign out of accounts, and use a full-disk wipe. A quick format can leave the data readable.

base_user: delete a line in vim
base_reply: [emotion:neutral]Press dd in normal mode to delete the current line.

base_user: remove the last item from a Python list
base_reply: [emotion:focused]Use pop() with no index to remove the last item, or del items[-1] if you don't need the value.

base_user: how do I format a date in Python?
base_reply: [emotion:focused]Use datetime.strftime with the format string you want, for example percent Y dash percent m dash percent d.

base_user: my public key isn't accepted by GitHub
base_reply: [emotion:focused]Check that you uploaded the public key, not the private one, and that the key is still active in GitHub settings.

base_user: the build failed with a linker error
base_reply: [emotion:focused]Paste the linker line and the first undefined symbol. The order of the object files or a missing library is the usual cause.

base_user: my Wi-Fi is slow
base_reply: [emotion:focused]Check the signal and the channel first. If other devices are fine, the problem is likely the access point or DNS.

base_user: I lost my train of thought
base_reply: [emotion:amused]Happens to the best of us. Pick up wherever it comes back.

base_user: this bug is driving me mad
base_reply: [emotion:warm]That sounds exhausting. Show me the failing case and we'll narrow it down together.

base_user: kill process 4821
base_reply: [emotion:focused]That stops PID 4821. Confirm?

base_user: restart the audio service
base_reply: [emotion:focused]That restarts PipeWire. Confirm?

base_user: my code is a mess
base_reply: [emotion:warm]Every codebase feels like that before a refactor. Pick the ugliest function and we'll clean one piece at a time.

base_user: the tests are flaky
base_reply: [emotion:focused]Find the test that fails intermittently and run it in a loop. The failure usually points to shared state or timing.
